flow-definition.description: Experiment: codesign /bin/ls copy WITH keychain partition list applied (issue #4)

definition.script:
node('ios-m4') { timestamps { timeout(time: 15, unit: 'MINUTES') { stage('codesign experiment: WITH keychain partition') { withCredentials([file(credentialsId: 'ios-dummy-p12', variable: 'P12_FILE'), string(credentialsId: 'ios-dummy-p12-pass', variable: 'P12_PASS')]) { sh '''#!/bin/bash set -u export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH" VARIANT="PARTITION" echo "=== codesign experiment: $VARIANT ==="
KC="codesign-exp-${BUILD_NUMBER}-${VARIANT}" rm -f ./ls-binary-test
security delete-keychain "$KC" 2>/dev/null || true if ! security create-keychain -p "$P12_PASS" "$KC"; then echo "FAIL: create-keychain"; exit 2 fi security unlock-keychain -p "$P12_PASS" "$KC" if ! security import "$P12_FILE" -k "$KC" -P "$P12_PASS" -T /usr/bin/codesign -f pkcs12; then echo "FAIL: p12 import"; exit 2 fi
# codesign resolves identities via the user search list; --keychain alone is not enough security list-keychains -d user -s "$KC" ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
echo "--- applying set-key-partition-list ---" security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$P12_PASS" "$KC" > /dev/null 2>&1 echo "partition list applied"
IDENT=$(security find-identity -p codesigning "$KC" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[)]/{print $2; exit}') echo "identity hash: ${IDENT:-NONE}" [ -n "$IDENT" ] || { echo "FAIL: no identity in keychain"; security delete-keychain "$KC"; exit 2; }
cp /bin/ls ./ls-binary-test
RC_SIGN=99 echo "--- codesign attempt ---" codesign --force --sign "$IDENT" --keychain "$KC" --timestamp=none ./ls-binary-test 2>&1 | tee codesign-output.txt RC_SIGN=${PIPESTATUS[0]} echo "codesign rc=$RC_SIGN"
RC_VERIFY=99 if [ "$RC_SIGN" -eq 0 ]; then echo "--- verify ---" codesign -dv ./ls-binary-test 2>&1 | head -6 RC_VERIFY=0 else echo "verify skipped (sign failed)" fi
security list-keychains -d user -s ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db security delete-keychain "$KC" 2>/dev/null || true rm -f ./ls-binary-test
echo "" echo "================ RESULT ================" echo "variant=$VARIANT codesign_rc=$RC_SIGN verify_rc=$RC_VERIFY" if [ "$RC_SIGN" -eq 0 ]; then echo "VERDICT: SIGNING SUCCEEDED" else echo "VERDICT: SIGNING FAILED" fi ''' } } } } }
